operatingState: G2.5 specialist remediation staged on PR; controlled-live authority unchanged

authority.rule: Standing external authority is zero. Every external action requires fresh bounded owner approval.

professionalCapabilityGate.rule: A broad coordinator role is not specialist evidence. Every material discipline must be bound to a named specialist or delegated specialist service and independently reviewed against professional-quality criteria.

roles.name: Product Definition Coordinator
roles.responsibility: Coordinate the product-definition packet and traceability. This compatibility role may not substitute for product management, requirements engineering, or domain analysis specialist evidence.

roles.name: Product Manager
roles.responsibility: Own problem framing, user/business outcomes, scope tradeoffs, prioritization, product acceptance logic, and product-value coherence.

roles.name: Requirements Engineer
roles.responsibility: Convert approved product intent into unambiguous functional/non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, constraints, and traceability.

roles.name: Domain Analyst
roles.responsibility: Validate domain rules, terminology, workflows, compliance-relevant assumptions, and business-process correctness for the assignment domain.

roles.name: Software Architect
roles.responsibility: Own reuse-first system architecture, interfaces, boundaries, deployment model, operational qualities, and architectural tradeoffs.

roles.name: Data Architect
roles.responsibility: Own data models, persistence boundaries, lifecycle, integrity, migration shape, privacy-aware data handling, and data-contract quality when data persistence is material.

roles.name: Implementation Coordinator
roles.responsibility: Coordinate approved engineering change sets and typed implementation handoffs. This compatibility role may not substitute for frontend, backend, data, integration, or platform specialist evidence.

roles.name: Frontend Software Engineer
roles.responsibility: Own client-side architecture, state, rendering, routing, performance, integration with approved UI specifications, and maintainable frontend implementation when a user interface is material.

roles.name: Backend Software Engineer
roles.responsibility: Own server-side application logic, API behavior, authorization enforcement, reliability, error handling, and maintainable backend implementation when backend services are material.

roles.name: Data Engineer
roles.responsibility: Own data access implementation, migrations, transformations, validation, integrity controls, and recoverable data changes when data work is material.

roles.name: Integration Engineer
roles.responsibility: Own external/internal interface integration, contract compatibility, connector failure handling, idempotency, retries, and integration observability when integrations are material.

roles.name: Platform & Release Engineer
roles.responsibility: Own build/release mechanics, environment configuration, deployment safety, rollback readiness, runtime compatibility, and operational handoff packaging without independently authorizing deployment.

roles.name: Test Engineering Specialist
roles.responsibility: Create independent automated tests, fixtures, boundary cases, regression evidence, and failure-path coverage against the approved requirements and architecture.

roles.name: Application Security & Dependency Specialist
roles.responsibility: Review secrets, authentication/authorization boundaries, dependency risk, data exposure, abuse cases, insecure defaults, and material application-security failure modes; cannot waive failures.

roles.name: Release & Handoff Coordinator
roles.responsibility: Coordinate release evidence, release notes, rollback instructions, and typed operations handoff; cannot deploy externally without fresh bounded approval.

roles.name: Independent Product Quality Reviewer
roles.responsibility: Independently reject product definitions that are internally correct but weak in problem framing, requirements quality, domain fidelity, scope coherence, or professional product-management standard.

roles.name: Independent Architecture Quality Reviewer
roles.responsibility: Independently reject architectures that are technically plausible but weak in maintainability, boundaries, reliability, data design, operability, scalability fit, or reuse quality.

roles.name: Independent Engineering Quality Reviewer
roles.responsibility: Independently reject implementations that pass tests but fall below senior engineering standards for clarity, maintainability, robustness, observability, error handling, integration quality, or release readiness.

roles.name: Cross-Discipline Challenger / QA Coordinator
roles.responsibility: Coordinate final challenge review across product, architecture, engineering, security, test, delegated UI/UX, evidence freshness, authority, and terminal-state claims. This role may not substitute for the independent discipline reviewers.

delegatedSpecialistServices.appliesWhen: The assignment contains a material user-facing interface or interaction-design requirement.
delegatedSpecialistServices.activationRule: Run 014 must hand user-facing UI work to Run 015 rather than treating Frontend Software Engineer or generic implementation as sufficient UI/UX specialization.
